description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
